args.title: Double charge on capture retry after card network timeout
args.body:
## Summary
Customers are being charged twice when the card network times out during checkout and the capture is retried.

## Reproduction
1. Start checkout
2. Card network times out on the first capture attempt
3. System retries the capture
4. Two captures land on the same order

## Root cause
`retry.py` does not carry the idempotency key across the second attempt, so the retry is treated as a new capture.

## Impact
Approximately 40 orders per day affected.

## Status
Confirmed reproduced in staging. Proposed fix is to persist the idempotency key before the first capture attempt; PR #481 contains this change.

## Source
Filed from the discussion in Slack #payments, thread `18291`.
